verdict.rationale: Evidence directly shows Lowenstein Sandler represents both startups/founders (financings, exits, formation) and investors (venture funds, growth equity, PE, angel investors) in negotiating and structuring deals, giving two-sided market knowledge, reinforced by VentureCrush convening founders and investors together. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of cross-side market-terms expertise beyond the firm's own site, and no explicit client testimonial citing this dual perspective advantage.
